title: #099. Fix-and-Optimize Matheuristic (Rolling-Window MIP)
subtitle: Solve multi-period capacitated lot sizing by iteratively freeing overlapping setup windows in a Fix-and-Optimize matheuristic.

judge.m0: Output must be an object { setups, production, inventory, totalCost }.
judge.m1: setups[{p0}] must be binary (0 or 1, received {p1}).
judge.m5: Inventory flow conservation violated in period {p0}: net supply {p1} != demand {p2}.
judge.m6: Reported totalCost ({p0}) does not match recomputed lot-sizing cost ({p1}).
judge.m7: Lot-sizing schedule is feasible, but totalCost ({p0}) exceeds target ({p1}).
